title: Division-loop register update
statement: Let $C,d,x_0,p$ be natural numbers with $1\le x_0$, and let the binary input be arbitrary. Starting at the division-loop label with register values $(x_0,C+1,0,0,d)$ and input position $p$, the program reaches its finishing label with register values $(x_0,(C+1)x_0^d,0,0,0)$ and the same input position, appending no output, in at most $d\bigl(14(C+1)x_0^d+4\bigr)+1$ steps, uniformly for every output string already printed.
